name: Capital Securities Corporation Limited
summary: Capital Securities Corporation Limited operates in the financial securities industry in China. It operates through Wealth Management Business, Asset Management Business, Investment Business, Investment Banking Business, and Others segments. The company offers wealth management services, including mutual and private equity funds, margin and credit trading, trust, and credit services, as well as brokerage services, including trading, research, and product sales support services.
